gate: DIALECTIC (Phase 109 grounded cited memory synthesis, Tracks G + D3)
systemUnderTest: the memory_ask dialectic end-to-end (DIAL-01 grounded + cited + trust-first contradiction + mandatory abstention + DIAL-02 opt-in/off-the-recall-hot-path/citations-are-ids + DIAL-03 the citation->sourceId reasoning-tree in the recall-trace + the daemon wiring [the injected query-time seam + the per-agent createMemoryRecall factory] + the opt-in registry gate + the keyless mechanical gate)

models.note: The model block records the INTENDED costed-pass configuration (the same answerer + cross-MODEL judge pair as the 2026-06-01-phase106-baser baseline) for the DEFERRED answer-faithfulness lift. The KEYLESS run that backs this manifest calls NO model: the dialectic synthesis seam is an INJECTED deterministic STUB (a pure fn returning a fixed { abstain, answer, citedIds }), the recall fixtures are synthetic, and the recall pipeline is the live LLM-free createMemoryRecall (a pi-ai spy proves 0 model calls). cross-PROVIDER judging with claude-opus-4-8 is the costed re-run — opus is used as a judge ONLY when the answer lane is non-Anthropic (an answerer must never be its own provider's judge).

measurementsTaken.name: opt-in / default-OFF (the cost gate)
measurementsTaken.result: PASS - with dialectic.enabled false/absent the memory_ask tool is ABSENT from the built tool set (the registry conditional gate `(ctx) => ctx.dialecticEnabled === true` filters it BEFORE build); on => present. The gate predicate is replicated in-package (the agent has no @comis/skills edge); the REAL memory_ask descriptor + conditional are authoritatively pinned in tool-registry-parity.test.ts. Mechanical, keyless, $0 - NOT a QA-accuracy lift.

measurementsTaken.name: recall stays LLM-free (the binding constraint)
measurementsTaken.result: PASS - a full createMemoryRecall run over the fixture adapter makes ZERO model calls (the pi-ai completeSimple + getModel spies record 0 invocations). The dialectic is the SOLE query-time LLM surface; the recall hot path remains deterministic + LLM-free. Mechanical, keyless, $0 - NOT a QA-accuracy lift.

measurementsTaken.name: citations are real recalled ids (anti-hallucination)
measurementsTaken.result: PASS - a stub seam emitting a BOGUS id (never recalled) => the bogus id is DROPPED by assembleSynthesis; the assembled citations are a subset of the recalled ids (a forged/garbled citation can never enter the answer). Mechanical, keyless, $0 - NOT a QA-accuracy lift.

measurementsTaken.name: mandatory abstention (the abstain-without-LLM invariant)
measurementsTaken.result: PASS - empty / irrelevant recall => abstained:true AND the stub seam is NOT called (seamCalls=0). Abstention on weak grounding is decided in CODE before any LLM call (it saves the call AND makes abstention a property of the composition, not the prompt). Mechanical, keyless, $0 - NOT a QA-accuracy lift.

measurementsTaken.name: trust-first contradiction (the HARD trust boundary)
measurementsTaken.result: PASS - a `system` current-truth is ordered BEFORE a contradicting `external` claim in the grounding the seam receives (orderByTrust on the system>learned>external ladder, read from entry.trustLevel only); the highest-trust item is first. The lower-trust contradiction is never blended (trust is a HARD boundary). Mechanical, keyless, $0 - NOT a QA-accuracy lift.

measurementsTaken.name: sourceIds in the recall-trace (DIAL-03 reasoning-tree provenance)
measurementsTaken.result: PASS - the citationChains reasoning-tree carries the validated citation -> recalled-id -> sourceIds chain (sourceIdCount=2 for the cited memory), and it is IDS ONLY: the serialized chain never contains the memory body text (noBodyLeak). An operator can trace each cited claim to its source memory without the body leaking into the trace. Mechanical, keyless, $0 - NOT a QA-accuracy lift.

deferredToOperator.name: the costed answer-faithfulness / grounding QA-accuracy lift (the costed QA delta)
deferredToOperator.why: Needs a real answer model (to answer grounded questions over the live memory.ask path), a real LLM judge (cross-judge >=2 per the credibility protocol), AND a real cheap cron-model synthesis seam (not the keyless stub) to produce real synthesized answers. All three cost real spend + keys. The keyless bench injects a stub seam and uses synthetic fixtures, so it proves the MECHANISM at $0 (grounded-only, abstaining, trust-first, citation-validated, provenance-traced) but produces no accuracy number; a fresh accuracy number here would be fabricated.
deferredToOperator.reproductionCommand: populate scripts/bench-memory.env (COMIS_BENCH + COMIS_BENCH_ANSWER_* + COMIS_BENCH_JUDGE_* variable NAMES), enable agents.<id>.dialectic.enabled with a real provider key, then extend + run packages/agent/src/memory/benchmark/qa-judge-harness.bench.test.ts to score each live memory.ask answer for grounding (every claim traceable to a cited recalled id) + abstention-correctness under the answer model + two judges; record per-category accuracy + N + significance + cost + latency.
deferredToOperator.baselineToDiffAgainst: benchmarks/results/2026-06-01-phase106-baser/ (the v2.9 baseline the recall hot path must not move when the dialectic is off)

coi.disclosure: Comis authored this benchmark harness. No competitor number, no cross-judged accuracy delta, and no comparative-ranking framing appears anywhere in this manifest. The dialectic is measured only against its own mechanical invariants and the v2.9 baseline the recall hot path must not move when off.

coi.rawTranscriptRelease: On the operator-costed re-run, the raw answer + judge transcripts for the grounding / answer-faithfulness lift are released alongside the dated row under benchmarks/results/history/<date>-<commit>.json so any accuracy number is auditable end-to-end.

honestyProtocol: Every number traces to a committed claim*-report.json, read back from disk before quoting. The six mechanical claims (opt-in/default-OFF, recall-stays-LLM-free, citations-are-real-recalled-ids, mandatory-abstention, trust-first-contradiction, sourceIds-in-trace) are each labelled 'mechanical, keyless, $0 - NOT a QA-accuracy lift' and kept STRICTLY SEPARATE from the costed answer-faithfulness / grounding QA-accuracy lift (explicitly 'not measured - operator costed re-run', NOT a guessed delta). The keyless bench calls no answer model, no judge, no key, no provider: the synthesis seam is an INJECTED pure stub, and a pi-ai spy proves the recall pipeline makes 0 model calls. A post-run credential-shape sweep over the manifest is clean: it carries pure numbers + booleans + prose, no credential field names or secret-key/bearer-token shapes. This run ships DEFAULT-OFF (no committed config enables the dialectic).
